x: The appearance of Eric Stroud could bring a bit of depth to our long distance side as could Paul Wiltshire to our sprint team. Pat Duncan did manage to put on a set of gear and compete in club races although questions were asked as to who the friend was under his shirt.

He was, however, a little worried by newly signed Paul Wiltshire but still managed to win clearly. Bob Carter was 3rd ahead of last year's winner Bob Whitehead. 5th and 6th positions were filled by the youngsters of the Club Jonathon Dunsford and Stuart Bennett who were told to race between themselv…

Paul Wiltshire put up a distinguished time and to quote one of the judges, "could be very good if he will get his arms right". Doug Fotheringham for the second week led home Eric Stroud, although Eric was walking better than his "Garnet" performance.
We only had three starters and so had no team chance. John Hall walked a steady race to finish 5th with Paul Wiltshire and John Dunsford backing up.

John Moullin was first man home for the Bels in sixth place, backed up by Len Duquemin, John and Ray Hall. It must not be ignored that our Junior team were also second, even without Paul Wiltshire who would certainly have been in the first four.
